boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named College Park campus places for studying, making, reflecting, gathering, and taking in student-facing culture.

cards.title: Set up a focused study block at McKeldin
cards.subtitle: Main campus library
cards.notes: Use the Find a Space tool before arriving, then choose a carrel or bookable room that fits solo work, a meeting, or a quieter reset.
cards.short_summary: A main-library stop with individual carrels and multiple study-space formats.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD identifies McKeldin as its main campus library and lists individual study carrels on the third, fourth, and sixth floors, plus a Find a Space tool for individual and group study.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces & Tools | Student Success Office
cards.access_notes: Study-room availability and access rules vary; check UMD Libraries' Find a Space tool before going.

cards.title: Meet outdoors on the lawn by McKeldin
cards.subtitle: Outdoor mall in front of McKeldin Library
cards.notes: Bring a book, blanket, or low-key game for good weather, and leave room for scheduled programs and the main pedestrian path.
cards.short_summary: A central lawn that supports casual outdoor time and scheduled campus events.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD's Terp Traditions page describes McKeldin Mall in front of McKeldin Library as a place for Frisbee, naps, and studying in good weather; Stamp manages it as an outdoor event venue.
cards.source_title: Terp Traditions | Adele H. Stamp Student Union
cards.access_notes: The mall is also a reservable event space; do not obstruct scheduled activities or pedestrian routes.

cards.title: Use Stamp as an between-classes anchor
cards.subtitle: Campus Drive student union
cards.notes: Check the building's current events or food options, then use the union as a practical meeting point for a group, a meal, or student involvement.
cards.short_summary: A campus-life hub with dining, student organizations, programs, and meeting space.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD Student Affairs describes Stamp as a hub for connection where students can study, eat with friends, find student groups, and experience traditions and cultural showcases.
cards.source_title: Stamp Student Union | Division of Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: Building services and operating hours vary; consult Stamp's current hours before planning an indoor meetup.

cards.title: Make a group plan at TerpZone
cards.subtitle: Recreation center inside Stamp
cards.notes: Coordinate a bowling, billiards, or video-game session with friends, and check current availability or any reservation details before you head downstairs.
cards.short_summary: A Stamp recreation venue centered on bowling, billiards, games, and leagues.
cards.evidence_claim: Stamp says TerpZone offers recreation activities including bowling, billiards, and video games, and its site invites visitors to bowl, play games, and join a league.
cards.source_title: Explore Our Spaces | Adele H. Stamp Student Union
cards.access_notes: Confirm current operating hours, lane availability, and any activity charges with TerpZone before visiting.

cards.title: Add a gallery pause to a Stamp visit
cards.subtitle: Contemporary-art gallery inside Stamp
cards.notes: Look up the current exhibition first, then give yourself time to view the work and attend any gallery programming listed for that show.
cards.short_summary: A campus gallery devoted to contemporary art by emerging and mid-career artists.
cards.evidence_claim: Stamp describes the Stamp Gallery as dedicated to exhibiting contemporary art, with an emphasis on work by emerging and mid-career artists.
cards.source_title: Explore Our Spaces | Adele H. Stamp Student Union
cards.access_notes: Check the gallery's current exhibition and building hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Jim Henson Statue and Memorial Garden
cards.title: Photograph Jim Henson and Kermit on the bench
cards.subtitle: Memorial garden outside Stamp
cards.notes: Walk through the garden and take a respectful photo with the bronze bench sculpture; it is an easy landmark to pair with a Stamp visit.
cards.short_summary: A memorial garden featuring a bronze sculpture of Maryland alumnus Jim Henson and Kermit.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD's Arboretum says the garden features a bronze statue of Kermit the Frog on a red-granite bench with creator and Maryland alumnus Jim Henson, and calls it a popular campus photo opportunity.
cards.source_title: Jim Henson Statue and Memorial Garden | Arboretum Outreach Center
cards.access_notes: Outdoor memorial garden; be considerate of other visitors and the landscaping while taking photos.

cards.title: Take a quiet lap through the Chapel garden
cards.subtitle: South side of Memorial Chapel
cards.notes: Walk the labyrinth or use a bench for a short pause, then leave the journals, memorial features, and reflective setting ready for the next visitor.
cards.short_summary: A contemplative Memorial Chapel garden with a labyrinth, benches, water features, and community journals.
cards.evidence_claim: Stamp says the Garden of Reflection and Remembrance includes a labyrinth for walking, benches, water features, and journals for community expression.
cards.source_title: Gardens | Adele H. Stamp Student Union
cards.access_notes: This is a contemplative garden beside Memorial Chapel; keep noise low and respect memorial areas.

cards.title: Find the program on Hornbake Plaza
cards.subtitle: Outdoor plaza by Hornbake Library
cards.notes: Use the plaza as a recognizable outdoor rendezvous, especially when a registered student organization has scheduled a table, gathering, or expressive activity.
cards.short_summary: A named outdoor venue used for campus organization events and gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: Stamp lists Hornbake Plaza among its managed outdoor venues, and its student-organization guidance identifies it as a reservable outdoor event space.
cards.source_title: RSO Event Guidelines | Adele H. Stamp Student Union
cards.access_notes: Events and tabling may require advance reservation through Stamp; respect any setup and access controls in place.

cards.title: Catch a scheduled gathering at Nyumburu
cards.subtitle: Outdoor amphitheater near Nyumburu Cultural Center
cards.notes: Check the campus calendar or student-organization announcements for a program, then arrive early enough to find seating without interrupting setup or performers.
cards.short_summary: A named outdoor amphitheater managed for campus events.
cards.evidence_claim: Stamp's event guidance identifies Nyumburu Amphitheater as an outdoor reservable event space and names it among outdoor venues that support student organizations' events and connection.
cards.source_title: RSO Event Guidelines | Adele H. Stamp Student Union
cards.access_notes: Programming is event-dependent; reservations are required for organized use of outdoor event spaces.

cards.entity_name: The Clarice Smith Performing Arts Center
cards.title: Put a Clarice performance on the calendar
cards.subtitle: Performing arts center on campus
cards.notes: Browse the season calendar for a concert, play, dance event, or community program, then confirm ticketing and arrival details on the individual event page.
cards.short_summary: The campus home for music, theatre, dance, performance studies, and the performing-arts library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Clarice says it is home to UMD's School of Music, Theatre, Dance, and Performance Studies, Clarice Presents, and the Michelle Smith Performing Arts Library, with performances and community programming.
cards.source_title: The Clarice | The Clarice Smith Performing Arts Center
cards.access_notes: Event schedules, ticket requirements, and accessibility details depend on the individual performance.
